name: Zi Shou
source:
After being saved from the space blockade in the middle of the circular city ruin, she said she was the bodyguard of Alessia.

She carries a M82A2 anti-material rifle, something she won't be separated with even in her sleep. It is incredible thinking she's never hurt herself. She speaks in a slow and paced way that gives shivers to whoever's listening.
